rule: Stand-ins and removals for the cell's missing pieces (R113). Each stand-in is a published piece of the same object and near size, drawn at the missing reference's transform by worldgen/export_interior_bundle.py; a decorative piece no kit holds is removed with its search recorded.

removals.search: Dawnguard.esm is not in the vault (skyrim-source/Data holds Skyrim.esm and Update.esm only) and the owner excludes its content (CLAUDE.md asset rule), so the base cannot be resolved to an object; no UESP page names the form id. With the object unknown, no same-object stand-in (R48) can be chosen; the published kit manifests hold no piece of this size and class that the cell could take instead (preflight-fix, 2026-10-09).
removals.note: A household object from an expansion we do not hold stood here. Its record is not in the vault, so the spot stays bare.

removalRule: Owner ruling 2026-10-04 (R113): no missing piece ships as a gap. A missing piece takes a same-class stand-in from a published kit where one exists (substitutions[]); a decorative piece whose class no published kit or vault archive holds is taken out of the fit-out (removals[], reason decorative-no-same-class, its search recorded), and the spot is simply empty. A placed piece whose only support was a removed piece is removed with it (reason rests-on-a-removal, restsOn naming that row).
